g.title: j904108357
g.text: You fool! What have you done?! Why, why go and delve into caverns where you are not welcome?!

g.title: j4158844579
g.text: I demand you fix this. This is your fault. I can feel it, clawing at me, tearing at me. Like some great beast.

g.title: j1963923291
g.text: Rid me of this. Rid me of this plague. Clear my mind of these memories. I know you can. Use this gift that you have and end it all. Now.

g.title: j309475164
g.text: Are you sure? But... you're smart, I get the feeling you'll figure something is up.

g.title: j4168892528
g.text: Those are a different kind of memory, Roathe. It won't work on them. They are buried deeper in your psyche.

g.title: j3899057325
g.text: Running and hiding from the truth won't work. We'll just wind up right back where we started.

g.title: j3919124641
g.text: Very likely. I will put two and two together and blame you for doing something I did not ask you to do. I am sure you will weather the storm.

g.title: j2444040588
g.text: That may be. You are very likely right. But I do not have any other options to try, now do I? It is worth the attempt.

g.title: j232093781
g.text: And if that is the case, then you can simply do the deed again. It is like you have an inexhaustible gift, isn't it?

g.title: j209895258
g.text: I am certain I will be hideously angry at you once I realize you have altered my memories, of course. And I recommend not telling me it was by my request, darling.

g.title: j3955635686
g.text: I will simply claim you are lying, and it will likely damage my opinion of you beyond repair.

g.title: j2558182393
g.text: No. I can't do this. I won't do this. We have to face down this situation together. Can't we just talk about this?

g.title: j1527171636
g.text: I... there's really no other way?

g.title: j1861214590
g.text: No. If you want the butler to go upstairs? You wipe my mind of all of this nonsense as I have asked. If you do not care? Then do as you wish. It matters not to me.

g.title: j1146256579
g.text: That, and, well, of course, our personal friendship is the only leverage I own in this situation. It is that simple.

g.title: j2786721293
g.text: What say you?

g.title: j172269280
g.text: Okay. I'll... I'll do it. I'll wipe your mind. Even if it'll take Marie and Lyon's with it.

g.title: j2710098741
g.text: No. I refuse. I'm sorry. We have to face this.

g.title: j2494914914
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j1132597268
g.text: Let's talk this through.

g.title: j3746202430
g.text: Hate me if you want. But I'm not going to do anything until we solve this, first.

g.title: j543348969
g.text: Good. Get to it.

g.title: j393124952
g.text: Do not dare - do not dare to speak to me of "calming down!" Do you not think I have every right to feel as though I am being torn in half?!

g.title: j644565083
g.text: Fascinating. Fascinating and unexpected. Explain.

g.title: j4072107213
g.text: Add 1 to Promise counter

g.title: j4291580379
g.text: I feel as though I have had the very understanding of myself, the very basis of my foundation, cracked and torn open like damnable Lua herself! Rewritten in ink that runs. Coward!

g.title: j648628942
g.text: I did what I did because it needed to happen. You couldn't hide from this any longer.

g.title: j151939892
g.text: Think of me what you will. But I know a spiral when I've seen one.

g.title: j302033967
g.text: Boolean RoatheWillReset is now true.

g.title: j3831381518
g.text: And you dare to tell me to "calm down?!"

g.title: j401825127
g.text: Boolean RoatheFail is now true.

g.title: j3753345552
g.text: Yes, I do think you would be a bit of a "connoisseur" of such things, wouldn't you? Go on.

g.title: j1830055178
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j3321948837
g.text: Within me is a malestrom of a rabid beast, eating away at my ribcage from the inside out.

g.title: j3276969946
g.text: If you wish to seek forgiveness, you can. But you need to want it. You need to choose that path. No one else can.

g.title: j557980458
g.text: If you want to choose to blaze a path on your own? For yourself? Do it. Don't apologize. But that is your path to choose, no one else's.

g.title: j2564394485
g.text: Being angry isn't going to solve anything, Roathe. You're angry because you're scared to face what you did. And what you've become.

g.title: j1830055178->j2564394485
g.text: RoatheForgivenessShortcut

g.title: j1166668532
g.text: Fine. Be angry. But use that anger for something worthwhile. Use it to shake loose all this hatred you have in you that you're pointing in the wrong direction.

g.title: j1830055178->j1166668532
g.text: RoatheVillainyShortcut

g.title: j2318547072
g.text: Evaluate expressions on Thermostat counter

g.title: j1830055178->j2318547072
g.text: false

g.title: j1716045212
g.text: And I do not know how to sate it. I do not know that I can. I had hoped that these conversations might have shown me a way; but I see now that this is fruitless.

g.title: j3217127019
g.text: You are not defined by your past, Roathe. You are defined by your future. And you still have a future to spend, unlike all the Orokin who died at the Night of the Naga Drums.

g.title: j3689504920
g.text: You are not defined by the opinions of those around you. Or what they think of your actions. You are defined only by what you believe of yourself and your choices.

g.title: j1422205957
g.text: You're letting that anger tear you up inside. You could be using it to help you fight the people who are still destroying this world today. Here. Now.

g.title: j1008379212
g.text: You're pointing it at yourself. You should be pointing it at the world that is blaming you for doing the best you could to save it from the Orokin Empire.

g.title: j2997705170
g.text: I just wish I knew how to help you. I wish I knew what to say. It feels like you're torn in two directions. Which way do you want to go?

g.title: j2318547072->j2997705170
g.text: false

g.title: j1304063769
g.text: There is a solution though, is there not? You have it within your power to fix this... this horrible agony within my mind.

g.title: j1975336654
g.text: That is the only thing that defines you, now. You can change. And you can change the world around you. I guess my only question is, will you at least try?

g.title: j2907149580
g.text: And the simple fact of the matter is? You are one of the very few Orokin we know that survived the Night of the Naga drums. From my point of view? It was a strategic retreat.

g.title: j2630764241
g.text: You're letting that anger tear you up inside. You could be using it to help you fight the people who are still destroying this world today. Here. Now.

g.title: j2514075241
g.text: You are not defined by the opinions of those around you. Or what they think of your actions. You are defined only by what you believe of yourself and your choices.

g.title: j2516685314
g.text: Boolean RoatheFail is now true.

g.title: j2626923615
g.text: Usurper. Drifter. I am begging you now. Indeed, it is the only way I believe we can move forward, yes? It is for your own self-interests as well.

g.title: j3863243551
g.text: Try to forgive yourself and move forward?

g.title: j3400973831
g.text: Nothing more. Nothing less.

g.title: j172187071
g.text: That is the only thing that defines you, now. You can change. And you can change the world around you. I guess my only question is, will you at least try?

g.title: j487438829
g.text: And the simple fact of the matter is? You are one of the very few Orokin we know that survived the Night of the Naga drums. From my point of view? It was a strategic retreat.

g.title: j1652915264
g.text: I do not know, Usurper. And therein lies the greatest problem.

g.title: j1656887379
g.text: If you ever wish for the butler to go upstairs and reconcile with the Entrati family, you must do as I say. You must.

g.title: j512731418
g.text: Boolean RoatheRedeemed is now true.

g.title: j593329198
g.text: Boolean RoatheVillain is now true.

g.title: j3036495607
g.text: Try to forgive yourself and move forward?

g.title: j2340538314
g.text: Nothing more. Nothing less.

g.title: j302746492
g.text: Which is what...?

g.title: j4166535407
g.text: No. I know what you're going to ask, and the answer is already no.

g.title: j4184638724
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j704216064
g.text: Boolean RoatheRedeemed is now true.

g.title: j2196120962
g.text: Boolean RoatheVillain is now true.

g.title: j601541929
g.text: You have a gift. A gift that can undo time. Spiral it, if not loop it. And this has... an interesting effect upon the minds of Protoframes, by its attachment to the Infestation and its attachment to time.

g.title: j3643504314
g.text: If you can say to me that you have never once used your gifts to play with the minds of the Protoframes you call friends and lovers, and you can say it without a lie in your soul?

g.title: j1804112412
g.text: Very well. I concede and accept your argument. Thank you, Drifter, for... talking me off this particular ledge.

g.title: j3215094018
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j1562847284
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j3431562468
g.text: And our attachment, therefore, to time. I ask you now. No, I beseech you, to wield it now on my behalf. Take these thoughts away from me. Take these memories away from me.

g.title: j3766387529
g.text: Then very well. So be it. I will not ask this of you now. But if you have never once done it for your own amusement, curiosity, or to seek to undue errors you have made in the dealings with others?!

g.title: j2592420589
g.text: I appreciate it. More than you might know.

g.title: j485553077
g.text: Forgive myself for what I have done? And move forward into the future? Hm.

g.title: j2149326009
g.text: A retreat to win the war. Hm.

g.title: j2653574986
g.text: I have to forget taking the serum from Entrati. Please.

g.title: j2043301822
g.text: I must go. I am in the mood to drink a great deal of alcohol and stare off broodingly into the middle distance.

g.title: j1373770695
g.text: While I am slightly dubious of your reframing of the situation, I am... too tempted by this new future an what it might mean for me to resist it, Usurper. Drifter.

g.title: j3637177219
g.text: While I am... slightly dubious of your reframing of your events as a tactical retreat, I admit I am... in favor of it, all the same, Usurper. Drifter.

g.title: j614101136
g.text: Are you sure? But... you're smart, I get the feeling you'll figure something is up.

g.title: j1553255311
g.text: Those are a different kind of memory, Roathe. It won't work on them. They are buried deeper in your psyche.

g.title: j42602089
g.text: Running and hiding from the truth won't work. We'll just wind up right back where we started.

g.text: Chat ends. Next chat will be Roathe5Day2.

g.title: j3113008827
g.text: I need some time to think this through.

g.title: j4224279369
g.text: Okay. I'll... I'll do it. I'll wipe your mind. Even if it'll take Marie and Lyon's with it.

g.title: j905964980
g.text: No. I refuse. I'll find another way to convince you to move forward.

g.title: j3823340462
g.text: Time does seem to be something we have in abundance, doesn't it?

g.title: j1681549710
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j19276136
g.text: I wish you the best of luck.

g.title: j2378544752

g.title: j858690993
g.text: Good. Get to it. I tire of living with this knowledge in my skull.
